parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: The rotation lid is the top cover of the storage box, made of plastic, rectangular in shape, and attached to the base body via a hinge mechanism.
parts.Functional_description: It serves to cover and protect the contents of the box, preventing dust or external elements from entering.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge axis to open or close the box.

parts.name: Lock
parts.Basic_description: The lock is a small metallic component located on the front side of the box, used to secure the lid to the base.
parts.Functional_description: It locks the lid in place when closed, ensuring the box remains sealed until intentionally opened.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or slide slightly to engage or disengage the locking mechanism.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main compartment of the storage box, made of plastic, containing multiple internal sections for organizing items.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the stored items, providing structural stability to the entire box.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the foundation for the lid and lock components.
